regime_context: China A-shares CSI 300 environment shows a narrowing rotation with only 10 of 22 themes eligible. The dominant leader is Innovative Pharma & CXO (crowded, broad trend), but backtests confirm momentum is a modest focus lens, not a return forecast, and the absolute-trend gate offers no drawdown protection here. Macro narrative flow is dominated by AI/tech and geopolitics with high unscheduled share, but no per-theme triggers.
emerging_watch: Gold Miners (rank 2, durability 0.93, breadth 1.0, not crowded) is forming as a potential challenger. Watch for duration of momentum score above 1.0 and durability above 0.85; the watch retires if Gold Miners score dips below 0.7, durability below 0.75 for two days, or margin to leader Pharma widens above 0.6.

theses.subject: Innovative Pharma & CXO
theses.thesis: The theme holds rank-1 leadership with high score (1.45), strong durability (0.78, hurst 'trend'), and full breadth (1.0). Crowding (z=1.62) forces extreme caution, but trend-following persists; fading crowded leaders is a documented failure mode. Gate_helps is false and track record is poor, capping conviction.
evidence: narrative_rotation.ranks[Innovative Pharma & CXO]: score 1.45, durability_bar 0.78, breadth 1.0, hurst_tag 'trend'
headline.crowded true with crowding_z 1.62 – crowding-skeptic flags extension risk
theses.dissent: Crowding z-score of 1.62 marks a highly extended, one-sided positioning level; historically such extremes precede violent mean-reversion if momentum stalls, even without a reversal signal.

falsifier.text: Innovative Pharma & CXO ETF proxy (159992.SZ) lags CSI 300 by 5% over any rolling 10-day period before the check-by date

theses.subject: AI Compute & Optics
theses.thesis: Rank-3 score (1.092) reflects momentum in a handful of names, but breadth is an extreme 0.118 – participation is dangerously narrow. Durability (0.51) is modest and the absolute-trend gate provides no shield; whipsaw risk is high.
evidence: ranks[AI Compute & Optics]: breadth 0.118, durability_bar 0.51, hurst_tag 'trend'
theses.dissent: Trend is still technically trending and not crowded; a few liquid AI hardware names may continue to run, making an underweight stance early if dispersion persists.

falsifier.text: AI Compute & Optics ETF proxy (515000.SS) outperforms CSI 300 by more than 3% over the next 15 trading days

theses.subject: Industrial Metals
theses.thesis: Rank-4 score (1.052) with durable trend (hurst 'trend', durability 0.83), healthy breadth (0.846), and no crowding (z=-0.23). The theme provides a diversifying, non-crowded cyclical exposure. Conviction remains low given overall regime uncertainty.
evidence: ranks[Industrial Metals]: score 1.052, durability_bar 0.83, breadth 0.846, hurst_tag 'trend', crowding_z -0.23 not crowded
theses.dissent: As a cyclical/resource sector, Industrial Metals are highly sensitive to global demand shocks and China macro weakness; the trend can break violently on any demand scare.

falsifier.text: Industrial Metals ETF proxy (512400.SS) underperforms CSI 300 by 5% over the next 20 trading days

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger

watch.name: Gold Miners
watch.rationale: Rank 2 behind a crowded leader (Pharma CXO). Durability 0.93 (high, ‘trend’ tag), breadth 1.0, not crowded. Margin to leader is 0.315 — narrow enough to watch for a potential handoff should Pharma falter. The theme is not yet scorable, but its price structure is well-established and it is one of the few durable non-crowded trends in a narrowing rotation.
watch.watch_condition: Gold Miners’ momentum score remains above 1.0 AND its durability bar stays above 0.85.
watch.retire_condition: Gold Miners’ score falls below 0.7 OR durability bar drops below 0.75 for more than two consecutive days, OR margin to leader widens back above 0.6 — signalling the handoff hypothesis is off.
